verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw shows deep, concrete India-specific startup instrument coverage (FDI/startup notification reforms, ESOP capital-gains tax rulings, deep-tech recognition pathways) via induslaw-supp-startup-report/deeptech/esop, satisfying the Indian part of the story. However, the firm's offices and publications are India-only (induslaw-supp-offices), and while it is 'part of the CMS organisation' surfacing some international CMS updates (induslaw-supp-cms-network), there is no evidence of specific publications on UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, or French BSPCE. Missing for 10: dedicated content on UK EMI, German VSOP, French BSPCE, or other jurisdiction-specific startup equity/instrument rules beyond India.
